summary: Priority rebalancer feedback loop raising 5xx baseline for dedicated tenant
description:
Issue summary: Multiple customers (starting with Narra Health, dedicated tenant) observed a sustained elevation in server error rate (5xx) beginning 2026-03-10 06:15 UTC. Impact: ~3-5% of API requests returning 5xx for short-form and streaming calls; customer reports timeouts and degraded user experience. Timeline: - 06:15 UTC: first uptick in 5xx floor observed on edge dashboards. - 06:30 UTC: alerts triggered for elevated error_rate and downstream runtime restarts. - 07:05 UTC: customer reported increased failure rate to support. - 08:00 UTC: initial mitigations (traffic throttle) applied for the tenant. Environment: production (us-east-1) dedicated capacity.

Steps to reproduce (high level):
- Send mixed traffic with a 60/40 split streaming:non-streaming at ~120rps for tenant with priority tags (high/normal).
- Ensure prefetch enabled and aggressive priority rebalancer active in the routing config.
- Observe gradual increase in apigw 5xx and downstream runtime thread errors within 10-20 minutes.

Observed symptoms & logs (excerpt):
- Edge error-rate jump: baseline ~0.3% -> 4.2% within 40 minutes.
- Apigw logs: "upstream reset" and "502 returned after retries" correlated with connection queue growth.
- Runtime logs: repeated "worker-thread panic: evict-on-priority-squeeze" and "prefetch-lock timeout" before watchdog restarts.
- Autoscaler: frequent backfill and scale-down cycles visible during the window.

Impact: Customer-facing failed requests, elevated latency tail, increased retries and cost for customer. This is customer-impacting for Narra Health (dedicated).
steps_to_reproduce: Generate tenant traffic with mixed streaming and short text generation at sustained 100-150 rps
Enable prefetch and priority rebalancer on tenant routing policy
Observe apigw and runtime error rates over 30-60 minutes
investigation_notes: Initial correlation: spikes align with priority rebalancer window adjustments and frequent shard handoffs
Hypothesis 1: Rebalancer is oscillating under mixed-priority load causing connection thrash and prefetch-lock contention
Hypothesis 2: Prefetch lock contention increases runtime latency causing upstream timeouts and apigw retries -> amplified 5xx floor
Observed runtime thread panics reference an internal eviction path (see runtime log snippets in linked PR)
metrics_summary: Runtime restart count: +18 restarts in 1h for affected shard pool
Conn queue length on apigw: 40 -> 800 during peak window
workarounds: Temporarily throttle tenant ingress (applied) to 40 rps - reduced error-rate to ~0.9%
Disabled aggressive priority rebalancer for the tenant routing policy (rolled back to stable weights)
Pinned tenant to fallback model variant with lower prefetch aggressiveness
next_steps: Instrument rebalancer decision metrics (operator + weight oscillation) for canary shard pool
Add local prefetch lock metrics and expose timeouts to tracing
Deploy hotfix to rebalancer: add minimum hold-time to prevent oscillation (canary in staging)
Coordinate with SRE to stabilize autoscaler hysteresis to avoid backfill churn
